target.title: fix whatsapp debounce for rich inbound context
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

WhatsApp rich inbound messages could bypass the configured inbound debounce window. Images, locations, and quoted replies could trigger an auto-reply before nearby messages arrived, so the agent could answer with incomplete context.

## Why This Change Was Made

The WhatsApp auto-reply monitor was treating media, location, and quoted-message payloads as non-debounceable. This keeps only control commands out of debounce and lets normal context-bearing messages wait for the configured window.

## User Impact

Users who send an image, location, or quoted reply followed by more text should now get one response based on the fuller message context, instead of an early partial-context reply. Control commands still bypass debounce so stop/config commands stay immediate.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs --config test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply.web-auto-reply.connection-and-logging.e2e.test.ts -t "normalizes legacy flat listener messages and rejects partial nested input"`
- `git diff --check`
